items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This update resolves a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, 'StyleSmuggler') that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution and is actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including stored XSS, incorrect authorization, and path traversal, which could lead to privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 13 vulnerabilities, including critical unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks (CVE-2026-48358, CVSS 10.0) and unrestricted file upload flaws (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6).
